utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m running a bit late, but I can help sort the donations and carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Dane—thanks. Just come when you can, and I’ll save the donation sorting and box-carrying for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. First I want to check the parts list and make sure we know what’s already been gathered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help check the parts list. Send it over, and I’ll compare it with what’s already here.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive. What are you still short on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I’m still short on a few tools and some screws, I think. If you check what we’ve got, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a look and see what tools and screws we already have.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m happy to help if there’s anything needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you, Rey. I’m just trying to figure out what supplies and timing we need so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort through the supply list if you want. Just tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll look for anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get enough volunteers, or do you still need more hands?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard a second-hand update, but it sounds like they still need a few more hands. I can check around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Could you check who’s still needed and when they’d want help?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive's coming together nicely—folks are pitching in already. If you want, I can pass along the details and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. Let me know what tools or supplies they still need, and I’ll see what I can lend a hand with.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and get you the list of tools and supplies they still need. I’ll bring it by as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks about it this afternoon—want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please put me down. I’d like to know where and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you down and bring you the details this afternoon. It’s happening at the community center; I’ll make sure you get the time and date.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really willing to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — count me in. Just let me know what I should do next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Bo — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and ready to go. If you want, I can help sort the next tasks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m good for now, but I’ll check the next tasks when I get a minute.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Bo — just let me know when you’re ready, and I’ll keep things lined up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring anything they can. If you want, I can also help make sure everyone knows when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be great, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: tell them the time, the place, and that every little bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll tell everyone the time, the place, and that every little bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — thanks for the reminder. I can help out; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just some sturdy gloves and a flashlight would help a lot, if you can spare them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll grab a pair of gloves and my flashlight and bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help however I can with the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’m still checking on a few folks, but I’ll let you know what’s needed as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — just keep me posted, and I can jump in as soon as you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn—I'll swing by a bit late, but I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Dane — I’ll make sure everyone knows you’re coming late. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help however I can—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Let’s start with the donated tools first, then we can sort the boxes and make a quick list of what still needs pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I can help sort the boxes and make that pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that’d help a lot. I’m still gathering the list, but I’ll send you the latest as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just send it over when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Jules—please tell folks we’re gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll tell people we’re gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thanks. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by around 2 o’clock, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to help keep track of the repair drive—where should we start?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful—let’s start with the list of needed repairs and who’s available to help. I can organize the tasks and keep everything moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll jot down the repairs and note who can help with each one. Tell me the first item on the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive? If so, what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on. Could you bring the spare gloves, a marker, and any small tools you have, and I’ll double-check the rest before we go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the spare gloves, a marker, and a few small tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you check what supplies we’re still short on and jot down anything you can bring? I’m keeping track, so that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check what we’re short on and make a note of what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest myself—what’s the word on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I might’ve missed the latest too. I heard folks were still gathering things, but I’m not sure what’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m in the same boat—mostly hearing bits and pieces. If you hear anything solid, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on for today — same spot, same time. I’ll let you know if I hear any last-minute changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — same spot and same time today, then?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going slowly, but it’s helping. I’m just trying to keep things moving one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That makes sense — steady progress still counts. Let me know if there’s anything I can help carry or drop off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just thinking about that. I can help out, but you may need to remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — I can send you the current list and we’ll pick one task to start with.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — send me the list and I’ll pick one task to start with. If I forget again, just nudge me and I’ll get back on it.
